title: Transformer Heads Looking for Order
abstract: arXiv:2609.25588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this note, we show that the problem of checking, whether a sequence of bits is ordered, is not doable by 1-head 1-layer transformers but is doable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer. Unlike similar previous results, our results assume the model where transformers have an output MLP.

Abstract: arXiv:2609.25588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this note, we show that the problem of checking, whether a sequence of bits is ordered, is not doable by 1-head 1-layer transformers but is doable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer. translated_abstract: 在这篇短文中，我们证明了检查一个比特序列是否有序这一问题，单头单层Transformer无法完成，但双头单层Transformer可以完成。与之前类似的结果不同，我们的结果是在Transformer带有输出MLP的模型设定下得出的。
tldr: 本文证明单头单层Transformer无法判断比特序列是否有序，而双头单层Transformer可以完成该任务，且这一结论在包含输出MLP的模型设定下成立。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that checking whether a sequence of bits is ordered is impossible for a 1-head 1-layer transformer but achievable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer, under a model where transformers have an output MLP.
